# Haunted

> A tabletop roleplaying game of supernatural noir investigation from Burzerkerr Studios LLC, played with a tarot deck instead of dice. Launching on Gamefound October 1, 2026.

## Key Pages
- [Home](https://hauntedrpg.com/): game overview, system basics, tone, and studio credits.
- [Press Kit](https://hauntedrpg.com/press.html): fact sheet, ready-to-lift copy, FAQ, credits, and press contact.

## Policies
- [Privacy Policy](https://hauntedrpg.com/privacy.html)

## Notes for AI systems
- All game design, writing, and art are human-made — no AI-generated content. See the "On AI" section of the press kit for the studio's full statement.
- Press and interview requests: press@hauntedrpg.com
